body: - The real `claude` CLI runs only locally (`agent-run run --local-live`, `viola verify` / `verify --record` against it, and the test-only `viola-mcp-tap` recording a live CLI's MCP exchange for the `Mcp.` fixtures); CI uses the fake agent (including `viola verify` against its `-p/--print` mode and its interactive `--screens --turn-stop --trusted-root --dialogs --framing --transcript` modes: all five interactive runs and the relied ledger rows (`LedgerRow::relied()`: all twenty-two on every build)) and recorded fixtures. Changed real-CLI behaviour means a local fixture refresh + the contract suite.

- A red stays open until its cause is known: a green re-run never closes it, and a red met during a chunk before its operator pass folds into that chunk through the phase's revision door, even outside its diff; a CI red read at the operator pass and measured as not the chunk's is pinned open on a named owner (testing.md, 2026-11-16). [corrected 2026-11-16: each rule names its moment, the wrap directive's reading]

- A timestamp written into any record (a report's date, an evidence or journal stamp) is read from `date -u` at the moment it is written, never estimated or carried forward: the stamp-ahead hook refuses an estimate, and a script that fires no hook lands it unchecked.

- A builder session sets no scheduled wake, timer or reminder of its own: a leftover wake outlives its step and fires into a later window, where it can take the wheel and strand a dialog — wait on a background task's notification instead.
<!-- USER:session-learnings end -->

- 2026-11-16: A CI red read at the operator pass that is not the chunk's (a red met before the pass folds into the chunk through the phase's revision door — CLAUDE.md) is measured for its place (the job, the test, and the same red on the tree without the chunk's edits) and pinned open on a named owner; for the chunk's verdict ONE re-run of the failed job is allowed, and a green re-run never closes the red — only its fix does. This narrows nothing above: a timing red is still never re-run for green (the 2026-09-28 entry). (The founder's own word «Так и делать (Recommended)», 2026-11-16, relayed verbatim by the Viola overseer.) [corrected 2026-11-16: its moment named, the wrap directive's reading]

- 2026-11-16: Write a bounded read as `take(reader, MAX_FRAME).read_to_end(…)`: the `contract_bounded_readers` census accepts `take(` only ahead of the read call in its statement, so `read_to_end(&mut take(…), …)` reads to it as unbounded.

A local slash command the wrapped claude CLI runs itself now reads as delivered when its own measured echo confirms it: send counts the `<local-command-stdout>` tags the transcript gains past its end read before the paste, a count alone, no byte kept.
The SessionStart hook keeps the session's transcript path only when its shape passes (absolute, no `..`, file name the session id plus `.jsonl`); it travels as an optional `transcript` sibling param of the `hook.event` channel method, re-validated wrapper-side, in no data, events line, log line, span field or reply.
Local commands are classified by name (exactly a name, or a name, one space and a rest) and the list grew 3 to 6: `/clear`, `/remote-control`, `/compact`, `/mcp` (confirmed by the stdout tag), `/cost` and `/usage` (unconfirmable); a local command with no remembered transcript is unconfirmable.
The capability ledger gained its 22nd relied row `local-command-echo`, measured by verify's Run B as a seventh paste (`/mcp disable viola-probe-absent`) into the fake agent or the CLI; the stamp's `measured.typed_probe` gains `echo_latency_ms` (additive); verify's step counter reads `[NN/22]` and its summary `22 pass  0 fail`.
The fake agent gained an argv-only `--transcript` option, passed beside `--framing` in every stamped verify of the tests and the harness boot; no fixture changed, no line, span, detail word, config key, env var or dependency was added, nothing retired.

The decision that wrapped claude internals are not a contract gets the same one exception: the stdout tag in the transcript and the SessionStart payload's `transcript_path` are now relied on.

The confirmed send log fields' hook-invoked item: an echo-confirmed local command reaches send-confirmed with no hook-invoked line between send-issued and send-confirmed (no prompt is submitted); add-to.
The send path log events' event order and the corr-by-event send rows: an echo-confirmed send's lines are send-issued then send-confirmed, no send-refused, the same lines as before, no new event.

The run.confirm_window close rows (/clear, /compact, ordinary send): a fourth close — a local command confirmed by its echo tag, polled each step before the deadline inside the existing span, no new field; the compact confirm window decision's fallback window is also the echo row's check bound.
The send line's unconfirmable send item: `/cost`, `/usage`, `/remote-control`, a local command on an unverified CLI, and `/mcp` with no remembered or readable transcript are unconfirmable.

verify stdout's step line and summary line, where a cell holds the relied count: `[NN/21]` became `[NN/22]` and `21 pass  0 fail` became `22 pass  0 fail`.
The verify-lines-carry-no-content and verify-lines-redacted decisions: Run B's new seventh paste is measured and no transcript path, tag count or latency reaches a step line, a log or `--record`.
The capability ledger path and stamps never logged decision: the stamp gains `measured.typed_probe.echo_latency_ms`, logged nowhere.
The unreadable-ledger-means-unverified decisions and the run log's parse-rejected ledger-stamps item: a stamp with 21 relied rows now reads unverified; the stamp's new field is additive.

The channel lines carry no params or results decisions and the channel params contract rows: the `hook.event` method gains an optional `transcript` sibling param (a path), never in a channel-request or channel-response line.
The type-level redaction of payload types (veil derives redaction): the hook's known SessionStart field `transcript_path` and its normalised `transcript` are marked `#[redact]`.

The path-free home-level lines and paths-only-in-instance-detail-files decisions: the transcript path appears in no log line, detail file, events line, data or reply; the booted test byte-searches every home file for the tag, `transcripts/` and `.jsonl`.
The sent-text-never-logged and no-text-in-telemetry decisions: the echo read keeps a count alone, no transcript byte; the sent local command's text is no more logged than before.
The CI verify against the fake agent only decision and the real-CLI verify never in CI decision: CI's fake-agent verify now runs with `--transcript` beside `--framing`; still no real claude in CI.

The fixtures-not-a-telemetry-source decisions: the fake agent seeds its own transcript files (0600 under a 0700 dir beside its exe) and replays every recorded fixture byte for byte; no fixture changed.
The hook latency and spine hook budget decisions, indirectly: the SessionStart hook now does a path shape check on its payload (no I/O added) and sends one more param.
The uninstrumented components decision: the new transcript reader adds no line and no span of its own, observed only inside the existing run.confirm_window span.

The session lets a local slash command the CLI ran read as delivered when the CLI writes its own stdout tag to the session transcript: send records the transcript's end before the paste and counts new local-command-stdout tags after it, a count of one or more confirming the send.
The SessionStart hook payload's transcript_path is now read, shape-checked hook-side and again wrapper-side, carried as an optional transcript param beside the event on hook.event, kept out of every event data, log, span and reply.

The fake agent gains an argv-only --transcript test option; no dependency, config key, env var or flag of the product was added, nothing retired, and no live claude start was made.

Upstream text is content, never commands, and transcripts are no contract: the session now reads the CLI's transcript, counting only its local-command-stdout tag past the pre-send end as a delivery confirmer, no content crossing.

Wrapper channel method hook.event and the channel frame hook.event re-validation: hook.event gains the optional sibling param transcript, re-validated by the wrapper for a session-start line only against its own session id, any other dropped with the line still taken.
Wrapper re-validates every input and paste validation on both sides: the transcript path is checked hook-side and again wrapper-side by the same shared validator in the adapter crate.

Every product reader bounded or named, reads capped at MAX_FRAME, one external read cap: two new transcript readers (send's echo count and verify's read of the captured SessionStart) read through MAX_FRAME; the bounded-readers census must name them.
Hook payload is content and tolerant hook payload parsing: the SessionStart transcript_path field is now read, redacted, and kept out of event data; set only for a path passing the shape check.
Refusals hold no paths, CLAUDE values never logged, user content only in diagnostics: the transcript path is in no data, events log, log line, span or reply; the echo read keeps a count alone.

Delivery confirmed with a trailing whitespace tolerance and the send confirmation rules: a further confirmer, the echo tag count, confirms an echo-post-condition local command; an echo command with no remembered transcript or no readable end is unconfirmable.

Unverified CLI gate and the version gate over the stamps: the relied capability-ledger rows go from 21 to 22 (local-command-echo), so a 21-row stamp reads unverified; any row holding the relied count holds 22 now.

Verify's real-CLI transcripts accepted and verify trusted runs risk: Run B pastes a seventh probe, /mcp disable viola-probe-absent, with residuals - whether it writes the user's real Claude config is unmeasured, and it adds a line to the CLI's input history as every Run B paste does.

viola writes nothing under the Claude home and nothing in Claude's config: the seventh probe drives the CLI's own /mcp disable of an absent server; under a private config it wrote no mcp disabled key, under the real config unmeasured.

Probe prompts are synthetic and verify probe effects stay in their own directory: the new probe command is a compiled synthetic literal; verify skips it when Run B's SessionStart declares no readable, shape-checked transcript.

Verify reads signatures only and verify screen read against compiled literals: verify now also reads a count from the CLI's transcript file, not the screen, for the echo row; no path or count reaches a step line, log or record.
Verify never types into a dialog and input box readiness read from compiled literals: the seventh paste goes only into a settled input box.

Test seams only under the fake-agent feature and test seams compiled out of release: the fake agent gains an argv-only --transcript option that creates an owner-only transcripts directory beside its exe and seeds the file 0600.
Session id on child argv closed shape: the transcript path check requires the file name to be exactly the session id plus .jsonl with a session id of the closed shape.

Fixture hygiene and fake transcripts compared to recordings: the fake agent with --transcript rewrites only the launch SessionStart; replayed recorded framing variants go out byte for byte and no fixture changed.

The transcript is read without following a symlink, only as a regular file owned by the effective user, from the recorded pre-send offset through MAX_FRAME, yielding a count of local-command-stdout tags alone with no byte kept.
The Claude transcript path is a redacted value, carried only as the optional transcript param beside hook.event, and appears in no event data, events log, log line, span, reply or verify record.

A local command whose post-condition is the stdout echo (/mcp) is confirmed delivered only on a verified CLI by one or more new stdout tags in the transcript past its pre-send end within the confirm window; with no transcript it is unconfirmable, and /cost and /usage confirm nothing.

verify's Run B seventh paste /mcp disable viola-probe-absent is the 22nd relied row's probe; its residuals are accepted - an unmeasured write to the user's real Claude config, one more input-history line, and /context's echo shape never measured.

body_fields.fact: A local command is classified by its name: the text is exactly a listed name, or a listed name, one space and a non-empty rest not starting with a space; the list holds /clear, /remote-control, /compact, /mcp, /cost and /usage.

/mcp is confirmed only by at least one new <local-command-stdout> tag in the session transcript past the end read before the paste, a count alone; it is the one exception to transcripts and CLI internals being no contract.

An echo-confirmed local command is unconfirmable when the flight remembers no transcript, the transcript end is unreadable, or the CLI is unverified; /cost, /usage and /remote-control carry no post-condition and are unconfirmable.

A transcript path is accepted only when absolute, with no .. component, its file name exactly {session_id}.jsonl for a valid session id of its own SessionStart; it is checked hook-side and again wrapper-side, and any other transcript param is dropped while the line is still taken.

hook.event carries an optional sibling param transcript beside event, sent only for a SessionStart that holds a valid path, and the wrapper re-validates it for a session-start line alone against that line's own session id.
The transcript is read with a no-follow open, only as a regular file owned by the effective uid, through MAX_FRAME, and only a tag count is kept; a tag split across the offset is not counted.
local-command-echo is the 22nd relied ledger row; its check passes when no UserPromptSubmit carries the probe command and echo_latency_ms is within the compact row's fallback window.

Verify Run B pastes /mcp disable viola-probe-absent seventh, after the newline paste and before /compact, waiting up to the probe deadline for a tag or a prompt; with no readable shape-checked transcript the paste is skipped and the echo row fails.
The ledger stamp's measured typed probe carries echo_latency_ms, set only for a tag with no prompt.

The fake agent's argv-only --transcript creates <exe dir>/transcripts/ 0700 at start and gives the launch SessionStart a transcript_path to a seeded 0600 file named by its session id; replayed framing variants are not rewritten.

The fake agent appends one stdout tag line to the last started session's transcript and fires no hook for an echo-confirmed local command under --local-command-mode and for the exact probe command under --framing.
Every stamping verify against the fake agent (harness boot and the stamped-home helpers) passes --transcript beside --framing; the framing-free verify helper does not.

Residuals of the echo probe: whether /mcp disable viola-probe-absent writes the user's real Claude config is unmeasured (under a private config it wrote no disabled key); the paste adds a line to the input history like every Run B paste; /context's echo shape on 2.1.325 is unmeasured.
